vault.portable_metadata: reserved namespace only; never inject opaque AI state into existing frontmatter

compatibility.community_scope: top 25 registered community plugins by official cumulative downloads
compatibility.artifact_policy: unchanged released assets with recorded source, version and SHA-256

security.d15_rule: A reproduced unsafe-boundary conflict is disabled and visibly unsupported; missing implementation is not a security exception.
security.privileged_operations: main-process broker with validated IPC and revision-aware journal

ai.managed_service: OpenRouter-proxy client seam only; operated hosting, billing and paid entitlements are deferred
ai.changes: reviewable per-file changesets with revision validation, undo and recovery

release.main_push: checks plus clearly labeled preview artifacts and configured staging handoff
release.date_tag: vYYYY-MM-DD; exact calendar date, verified main ancestry and no overwrite
release.signed_release: requires external signing credentials; absent credentials fail the production gate
release.human_validation: separate handoff, never represented as automated pass

governance.staffing: estimate from P1 compatibility and safety evidence
